## Paperwork deadlineNew hires have five business days from their start date to complete
onboarding paperwork: the W-4 or local tax equivalent, direct deposit
details, the equipment agreement, and the code of conduct acknowledgement.
Payroll will not run your first paycheck until every document in that list
is signed. HR sends two reminder emails, on day three and day four, before
escalating an incomplete packet to your manager on day six.

## Meal limitsMeals while traveling are reimbursed up to fifty dollars per day, itemized
by breakfast, lunch, and dinner. A meal under twenty-five dollars does not
require an itemized receipt; a credit card statement line is enough. A meal
of twenty-five dollars or more requires the itemized receipt showing what
was ordered, not just the total, because tax auditors ask for it during the
annual review.

## Submitting a claim

Claims go through the expenses tool, not email or Slack. Attach a receipt
image for every line over twenty-five dollars, choose a cost center, and
add a one-sentence business purpose. Claims older than ninety days from the
expense date are not reimbursed except by an explicit finance exception,
which requires a director's approval.

## RevocationVPN access is revoked automatically when your account is disabled, and
manually when a laptop is reported lost or stolen. Report a lost device to
#it-requests immediately; revocation is usually completed within fifteen
minutes of the report during business hours.

## Common questions

**What port does the VPN client connect on?** Port 51820, over UDP, which
is the standard WireGuard port.

**Can I use one configuration file on two devices?** No, each device
needs its own configuration; sharing a key between devices causes random
disconnects as the two devices fight over the same handshake state.

**Does the VPN slow down my personal browsing?** No, split tunneling means
only internal-range traffic uses the tunnel by default.

# Incident response runbook

This page covers how Acorn Robotics classifies and responds to production
incidents, from detection to postmortem.

## Severity levels

Sev1 is a full outage or a safety-relevant failure in shipped hardware;
Sev2 is a major feature degraded for many customers; Sev3 is a minor,
workaround-available issue. Severity is set by whoever declares the
incident and can be raised or lowered as more information comes in, but
never lowered without the incident commander's sign-off.

## HolidaysCompany holidays are published at the start of each calendar year on the
HR calendar and do not count against PTO balance. If a holiday falls on a
weekend, the nearest working day is observed instead, announced at least
one month in advance.

## Common questions

**How many PTO days do employees accrue per year?** Twenty days per year,
accrued monthly.

**How much PTO can I carry into next year?** Up to five days; the rest is
forfeited unless local law says otherwise.

**Do I need to request sick time in advance?** No, just notify your
manager as soon as you know you will be out.

answers.passage_text:
# Security basics

Baseline security practices every employee at Acorn Robotics is expected
to follow, independent of role or team.

## Passwords

Passwords must be at least fourteen characters and must not reuse any of
your last ten passwords. Employees must rotate their password every
ninety days; the identity provider sends a reminder seven days before
expiry and locks the account if the deadline passes without a rotation.
A password manager is provided to every employee and is the recommended
way to generate and store passwords -- writing passwords in a notes app is
against policy.
